descriptions.w3d_e15a_offset_query_8004ed24: Copies the three-float offset vector at object+96 through a stack local, and when the unsigned caller value exceeds the object's integer base at +92 plus 1000, replaces the local's y with (float)(value-1000-base) times the float at 0x80377898 plus that y; then forwards the object and the adjusted vector to virtual slot 40 of the object's vtable, returning that call's result in r3.
